154.runtime_description:
Selector/Scanner. The Curve setting in the Properties decide between the Selector and the Scanner mode.

When Curve is set to None the module works as a Selector, switching one of the input signals to the output. The index of the selected signal is 0 for Pos < 1, 1 for Pos >= 1 and Pos < 2, 2 for Pos >= 2 and Pos < 3, and so on.

When Curve is set to Linear or Sine the output signal is obtained by crossfading between the two inputs whose indices are closest to the Pos value. The Sine mode delivers a higher level in the center position between two inputs.

When Wrap mode is selected in the Properties, Pos wraps around at its range limits which results in a repeating of the range.

323.runtime_description:
A bank of parallel bandpass filters that can create the partials for polyphonic modal synthesis. The filters can be used as resonators for the different oscillation modes of a system that behaves similar to a physical object like a string or a membrane. The input signal is comparable to an 'exciter' like a hammer or a bow.
   The decay time of the impulse response of a filter is determined by its resonance/damping. The filter output signals are multiplied by AL and AR and summed up per voice for the stereo output. GIn controls the amplitude of the exciter signal at the input of each filter. The frequency of a partial is controlled by P and an individual factor set by Rtio.
   The amplitude factors, frequency ratios and decay times can be controlled per partial by selecting the index of the partial at the Idx input.
   The Dmp input influences the decay of all partials of a voice like a damper that stops the sound.
   The number of partials per voice is adjustable in the Properties. It can also be dynamically controlled by the Num input.
   Changes at the control inputs will be applied by an event at the App input. This input can also be used to initialize a voice.

runtime_inputs.help: Number of active partials. Input values are rounded and limited to the maximum number set in the Properties. A new value will be applied with the next event at the App input. If Num is not connected all partials set in the Properties are active.
runtime_inputs.label: Num

runtime_inputs.help: Index of the partial (1-based, rounded). It has to be set before partial data are sent to Rtio, GIn, AL, AR and Dec. If Idx is outside of the range 1...Max, partial data will be ignored.
runtime_inputs.label: Idx

runtime_inputs.help: Pitch [in MIDI note numbers, 69 = 440 Hz]. Logartihmic control of the center frequency of all partials. The frequency is multiplied by the individual ratio (Rtio) of each partial. A new value is applied with the next App event.
runtime_inputs.label: P

runtime_inputs.help: Ratio of the frequency of the partial compared to the frequency given by P. New values are applied with the next App event. If not connected: 1, 2, 3, 4, ... (harmonics).
runtime_inputs.label: Rtio
